restoration_note: The teaching is a piece of cosmic onomastics describing three discrete degrees of emanation: gods (Father→celestial/Greatness), rich-men (gods→spiritual/Beloved of Lights), angels (rich→natural/Ambassador). The arc is governed by repeated formula 'ⲛⲉⲧⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ ⲭⲉ X ⲡⲉ ⲛ̄ⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ ⲛ̄...' (those whom they call X — it is the call of...). Most gaps are tightly constrained by this triple parallel and by visible flanking morphemes; small lacunae and standard formulaic line-end joins (the citation ⲭⲉ, the citation-noun ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ/ⲣ̄ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲟ, ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ, ⲡⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ) are all restored with high confidence. {11} (the subject of a 'when…' clause at line-end before line 3068) is too weakly constrained to fill: it could be the Father summoning, the first gods coming forth, or a different agent in the chain, and is left unrestored. {18} 'ⲡⲭ̄...' (where transmuted souls are reached) is restored with moderate confidence as ⲡⲭⲁⲭⲉ 'the Enemy' (the realm of mingling), following the editor.

restorations.basis: Completes ⲡⲓⲣⲉⲛ ⲭⲉ 'this name (namely)' — standard citation formula introducing the title-words about to be discussed.
Single-letter completion of ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ('angel'), one of the three name-classes introduced in the title.

~5 characters at line end completing the question 'what are these types?'; the term ⲛⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ recurs in the immediate vicinity (3057, 3071) and the chapter is explicitly about ⲡⲓϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲛⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ('the three types').
Joins line 3054 ending ⲛⲟⲩ with line 3055 beginning ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲟ to give ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲣ̄ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲟ ('rich god'); confirmed by parallel title formula ⲣⲙⲙⲁⲟ ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ in 3051.
Editor's restoration; immediate context repeats ⲍⲛ̄ⲉⲩ ⲛⲉ ('what are') three times. Accepted.
Completes ⲡⲓϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲛⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ('these three types'); explicit thematic number of the chapter, repeated at 3070.

restorations.proposed_english: in the Land of Light, with no measure unto
restorations.basis: Direct parallel to line 3071 'ⲉⲧϣⲟⲟⲡ ϩⲙ̄ ⲡⲕⲁϩ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ ⲉⲙⲛ ϣⲓ ⲁϯ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ' — same formula about the three types existing in the Land of Light without measure. Visible suffix ⲁⲩ confirms direction.

Completes the formulaic ⲛⲉⲧⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ ⲭⲉ ('those whom they call to them, saying'); this exact phrase recurs at 3074, 3087, 3089, 3091. The editor's ⲍⲱϩ is unnecessary — only ⲧⲉ is needed to span the line break.
3pl object suffix on ⲥⲉϩⲉ; the idiom ⲥⲉϩⲱⲟⲩ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'set them on their feet/upright' requires plural object referring to the gods just named.
Citation marker required by the recurring formula ⲛⲉⲧⲟⲩϯⲣⲉⲛ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ ⲭⲉ ⲣ̄ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲟ ('they name them, saying: rich'); identical structure used for each of the three name-classes throughout this teaching.
Completes ⲛⲣ̄ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲟ ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲱⲧ ('the rich-ones of the Father'); the form ⲣ̄ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲟ requires the missing -ⲁⲟ tail and a genitive ⲙ̄- before ⲡⲓⲱⲧ.

Line-end gap after singular article ⲡ-; the subject of the temporal clause ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲣⲉ ⲡ... ('when the X...') could be ⲡⲓⲱⲧ summoning, ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ coming forth, or another agent in the call-chain. No formula constrains the choice and the visible context does not preserve enough trace to decide.
Completes ⲛ̄ⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ('types'); same word that appears unbroken at 3057 and 3070 in the same formulaic phrase about the three types in the Land of Light.
3pl prefix completing ⲛⲉⲧⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩⲧⲉ ('those whom they name'); identical formula at 3061, 3087, 3089, 3091.
Single-letter completion of ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ('forth'); the same preposition appears unbroken in the same line at the second ⲁⲃⲁⲗ.
Completes ⲛ̄ⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ ('the call'); the predicate-noun phrase ⲡⲉ ⲛ̄ⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ ⲙ̄... is the chapter's defining formula (cf. 3066, 3081, 3088).
Preposition ϩⲛ̄ + plural article ⲛ̄- before ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ; the contrast ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲡⲥⲁⲙⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ ('above and below') requires the worlds to be locative.
Joins line 3084 to line 3085's initial ϣ to form ⲁⲩϣ ('they were able'); the next clause reads 'they were also able to come to all the souls', requiring this verbal form.

Completes ⲡⲭⲁⲭⲉ ('the Enemy'), the realm of mingling and metensomatosis where the Living Soul is held; the verb ⲭⲁⲗⲗⲁⲭⲟⲩ ('transmuted') just before makes the locus of mingling the natural reading. Cf. ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲭⲁⲭⲉ ('Enmity') brought low at 3076.
Completes ⲛⲉⲧⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩⲧⲉ ('those whom they name'); identical to {7} and to the formulaic phrase repeated throughout this page.
Completes ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ ('gods'), confirmed by line 3088 'it is all the gods reckoned to the house of the Greatness' which immediately follows and resumes this name-class.
Completes ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ('all of them'); same word appears unbroken in the parallel construction at 3088 ⲛ̄ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ.

Joins ⲁⲡⲏ at line end to ⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ at line start, giving ⲁⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲙ̄ⲡⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ ('to the house of the Ambassador'); parallel to 'house of the Greatness' (3088) and 'house of the Beloved of Lights' (3090) — the third house in the triadic seating, named for the Third Ambassador whose embassy reaches the souls.
